p.i: clientum numero hac animi tui significatione non exclusisse vide- deare. Faxit Deus Opt. Max. ut fis diu, plusplusque jospitet ipsum, quem adeptus es, Principatum. Francofordia, a. d. VI. Eid. Septemb. A. N. C. CIↃ. DC. VI.

page.notes: The date line reads "A. N. C. CIↃ. DC. VI." as printed in the old numeral form, which I have left as printed. The "Melchior Haiminsfeldius" signature is set in small capitals with a hyphen at the line end.
